parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the protective cap of a USB drive, made of plastic, typically small and lightweight.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the USB connector from dust, moisture, and physical damage when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It can be detached or reattached to the base body by sliding or snapping into place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the USB drive, made of plastic, housing the electronic components and connector.
parts.Functional_description: It contains the memory chip and USB connector, allowing data transfer between devices.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, except for insertion or removal from a USB port.
